name: ticking
title: Ticking
description: A portfolio for interior designers laid out like a furnishing-fabric sample book: every project is a pinked-edge cutting of ticking, gingham, trellis, spot or herringbone woven in CSS, with a stapled paper label giving its title, client and year in small spaced capitals over a typed reference line.

tokens.--font-body: serif for running text, descriptions on the labels and the opening sentence of a project
tokens.--font-label: grotesque for page titles, the small spaced capitals of labels, the menu, headings and project names
tokens.--font-typed: typewriter face for the reference line and client on each label, the spec values, the typed line above the title of the home page and /work/, the contact line on the home page and code
tokens.--font-figures: monospaced typewriter face for years: a date is clipped to its first four figures, so every figure must be the same width
tokens.--text-xs: size of the small spaced capitals: menu, label titles, spec labels, headings in page text, the reference line on a label
tokens.--text-s: size of label descriptions, typed lines, the site title, project names in the index and the footer
tokens.--text-l: size of the opening sentence on a project page and of titles in a list of posts
tokens.--text-xl: size of page titles — the one big voice
tokens.--leading-tight: line height of page titles and post titles in a list
tokens.--color-bg: page background — the white card of the sample book
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text off the labels: typed dates, menu entries not in use, the index heading, years, the footer
tokens.--color-accent: rose madder: the typed line above the book, the contact links on the home page, the current-menu underline, link underlines, the quote bar, focus rings
tokens.--color-rule: hairlines and the dashed rules on labels, the pinked rule above the footer and in page text, table rules, menu hover
tokens.--color-paper: the stapled paper labels, the project spec label, code blocks and the skip link; also the pale threads in the linen and the glint on a staple
tokens.--color-paper-ink: text printed on the paper labels and the skip link; also the fine slub threads in the linen
tokens.--color-paper-muted: the typed reference line and spec labels printed on paper
tokens.--color-paper-accent: rose madder printed on paper: the pattern number on each label
tokens.--color-linen: natural linen ground of every woven cutting, the band at the head of a page and the chips in the index; also selected text
tokens.--weave-red: turkey red of the gingham checks
tokens.--weave-green: bottle green of the trellis lattice
tokens.--weave-tweed: soft black of the herringbone tweed
tokens.--color-staple: the steel staple through each label and the one beside the typed line above the book
tokens.--color-shadow: soft shadow under the cuttings, labels and staples, and at the cut edge of a table that scrolls
tokens.--measure: maximum width of a column of text
tokens.--page-max: widest the page grows on a big screen
tokens.--space-1: spacing scale — hairline: between list items and lines of the footer
tokens.--space-2: spacing scale — tight: label rows, index rows, small gaps
tokens.--space-3: spacing scale — base: label padding, paragraph gaps
tokens.--space-4: spacing scale — roomy: around page titles and between cuttings across
tokens.--space-5: spacing scale — section: between rows of cuttings, above the index and the footer
tokens.--pinking: depth of the pinked zigzag teeth on cuttings and the band
tokens.--swatch-min: narrowest a cutting may be — smaller means more cuttings across
tokens.--swatch-ratio: shape of a cutting: width divided by height
tokens.--label-overlap: how far each paper label is stapled up over its cutting
tokens.--band-height: height of the ticking band at the head of a plain page; the selvedge on the book pages is a third of it
